{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# But we won't use it for conversion analysis
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders, exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Define strata by customer_segment
strata = filtered_data['customer_segment'].unique()

# Compute conversion rate within each stratum and channel
conversion_rates = filtered_data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute stratum-specific differences (email - paid_search)
differences = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute weighted average of differences, using stratum size in the combined population
# Total count per stratum in the full filtered_data
stratum_counts = filtered_data['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (differences * stratum_counts).sum() / stratum_counts.sum()

# Output
print("Conversion rates by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_rates)
print("\nStratum-specific differences (email - paid_search):")
print(differences)
print(f"\nWeighted average difference: {weighted_diff}")"}
